_comment: Issue #50 item 5 — the lightest migration-drift guard. Each entry lists columns that src WRITES on a save path; check-schema-drift.mjs probes the live PostgREST schema cache for each one and fails if any is missing (i.e. a migration exists in the repo but was never applied to prod — the Issue #49 root cause, where zog_snapshots.output_language was missing for months). Add a column here whenever a new save path depends on it.
